records.text: Three couples who attended the Turning Point USA conference told Lori Cardoza-Moore they were horrified by Tucker Carlson condemning Israel and praising Qatar.
records.speaker: Laurie Cardoza-Moore

appearances.snippet: I had three couples reach out to me who had been to the Turning Point USA conference and this was in Tampa a couple weeks ago they called me and said they were horrified by what they saw horrified they saw Tucker Carlson get up and act like ... condemning Israel, ... praising Qatar with his mocking voice and his mocking laughter.

verification.notes: The public speech video establishes the event and remarks, but the statement concerns private comments attributed through Lori Cardoza-Moore to three unnamed couples. No independently attributable account corroborates those reactions.

sources.title: Tucker Carlson at TPUSA Student Action Summit 2025
sources.relevance: Full public video provides event context but cannot substantiate the private reactions attributed to three unnamed couples.

records.text: Did Charlie Kirk condemn Tucker Carlson or defend Michele Bachmann after the conference remarks? No, he did not.
records.speaker: Laurie Cardoza-Moore

appearances.snippet: Then Charlie Kirk. ... Does he get up and condemn Tucker (Tucker Carlson) or correct Tucker (Tucker Carlson) for what he said about Israel and how dangerous Qatar is to us? No. ... Did Charlie (Charlie Kirk) get up and defend Michelle Bachmann? ... No, ... he didn't.

verification.notes: The allegation depends on proving an absence across Kirks later public and private communications: that he never condemned Carlson and never defended Bachmann. Current public sources do not establish that universal negative, so it is not verifiable.

I said Turning Point's not going to come out and tell you who wrote this message. ... this zionist who is spelling like you guys noted god putting a dash there you guys are like that's not how christians would write this it turns out that well lori cardoza more the brave report pulled up as an evangelical zionist who ... virtually everything that was said in this text message was also a rant that Lori (Lori Cardoza-Moore) decided to do live on the internet pertaining to Tucker (Tucker Carlson)'s totally sensible speech
